body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> LG presented ''KB6100'' 10.95mm-thick pocket TV phone with a leather case. This T-DMB phone features M-XD engine and 170-degree viewing angle for better viewing experience at any direction. You can record programs as watching the channels while this handset can be also used as a T-DMB receiver with USB port; if you connect the phone and PC with USB cable, you can watch DMB with bigger PC monitor. ‘MUVEE function’ enables you to make your own music video using photos and background music. Other features include 1.3M camera, mp3 playback, EV-DO service and leather case with different colors.
